channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Lucknow Horror: Neighbour Kills Widow & Her Visually Impaired Son Over ₹160 Dispute, Arrested After Police Encounter
item.description: Lucknow mason Kishan Rawat raped, murdered widow Reshma Bano and killed her visually impaired son Shadab over a ₹160 dispute.

item.title: Pakistan Launches Air Strikes on Kabul and Kandahar, Killing Four Civilians in Afghanistan Amid Rising Border Conflict
item.description: Pakistan’s air strikes on Kabul and Kandahar have killed civilians and displaced thousands amid escalating border clashes.

item.title: The Father Behind Sanju Samson’s 89 in India’s 2026 ICC T20 World Cup Triumph
item.description: A former Delhi Police constable’s life-changing decision to move to Kerala laid the foundation for his son’s match-winning World Cup brilliance.

item.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei Lost a Leg, In Coma After Deadly Airstrike: Reports
item.description: Conflicting reports say Iran’s leader Mojtaba Khamenei was critically injured in strike killing his father, officials say recovering.

item.title: New Income Tax Act From April 1: 7 Major Tax Changes Including STT Hike, ITR Deadline Extension Explained
item.description: India’s new tax framework and seven key reforms from revised ITR deadlines to STT hikes will take effect from April 1, 2026.

item.title: UP Board 2026: UPMSP Orders Action Against Both Students and Invigilators if Currency Found in Answer Sheets
item.description: UPMSP orders action against both students and invigilators if currency notes are found in answer sheets during 2026 board exams.

item.title: “Nobody Will Hire Women”: Supreme Court Declines PIL Seeking Mandatory Menstrual Leave Policy
item.description: Supreme Court declines nationwide menstrual leave mandate, warning compulsory policy may reinforce stereotypes and affect women’s employment.

item.title: A Rare Act of Kindness: Man Waters Trees on a Road Divider Every Morning Selflessly
item.description: A March 2026 viral video shows a commuter stopping along a busy road divider to water neglected saplings, earning widespread praise online.

item.title: Iran Clarifies Khamenei’s Wife Is Alive After Feb 28 Strike That Killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei
item.description: Iran says Khamenei’s wife survived Feb 28 Tehran strike; Mojtaba confirms father’s death and family casualties.

item.title: Surat Woman Murdered by Younger Son and Elder Daughter-in-Law for Opposing Affair, Both Arrested
item.description: A woman in Surat was brutally murdered by her own family members for opposing a secret affair.
